fieldValues.title: tombstone reference-only state: absent content file is valid
fieldValues.normative_statement: A source-document sidecar entry (RFC-038 [R25], amending RFC-017 [R12]; the entry no longer lives in a manifest `sourceDocumentIndex`, which is retired per RFC-038 [R2]) whose content file (at `contentPath`) is absent is a valid tombstone (reference-only) state. A conformant implementation MUST NOT reject, refuse to load, or refuse to export a repository solely because a discovered source document's content is missing. An `attaches` `SourceReference` targeting a tombstoned `documentId` remains conformant (I-102). An implementation MAY surface an informational non-blocking diagnostic that the content is unavailable.
fieldValues.applies_to: ext:repository validators, exporters; repositories with pruned source documents
